fields: IAM's name
Blocks changed (instrument 16b, Sample Globe).
In the field's terms
Number of 10-CpG blocks departing from the sample's expected healthy profile.
Definition
The count of 10-site blocks where the sample departs from its own expected healthy profile.
What it does
It counts where the sample departs from its own expected healthy profile (atlas cells mixed at its shares), block by block.
Why the instrument needs it
The Sample Globe shows WHERE the sample departs, so the count of changed blocks summarises how widespread the departure is.
How it is obtained or computed
Each site is read against the sample's own expected healthy profile in 10-site blocks, and changed blocks are counted; the change rule is not in the packet: open: not in the records yet.
Where it is read
10-site blocks across the genome.
Where IAM's Law enters
Not part of IAM's Law: geometry (a yardstick).
Long-form section
not part of IAM's Law
Healthy value and how it is set
Output: healthy is few; constructed healthy 1-2 of limit 50 (catalogue). The development test reads 36 of 79075; this reading is not used on sequencing.
Where its value comes from
computed by the chain from the sample's molecules and its references
Its setting on IAM's Law Sphere
a reading, not a setting (the lever map shows which settings move it)
Lever range (what moves, by how much)
open: not written yet
Limits and what is open
Not used on sequencing. A count says how many blocks changed, not why.

Width borrowed (one-library cells), instrument 16b, Sample Globe.
In the field's terms
Borrowed reference variance for cell types with a single reference library.
Definition
The healthy width borrowed for cells that have only one library in the reference.
What it does
It names, when used, which cells had their width borrowed because they have only one library.
Why the instrument needs it
A cell with one library has no spread of its own, so its width must be borrowed and the borrowing named.
How it is obtained or computed
Named when used; where the width is borrowed from is not in the packet: open: not in the records yet.
Where it is read
not genome-located: a list of cell types.
